## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- roundCentsHalfEven (banker
- rounds normally when not on a cent tie
- breaks a cent tie toward EVEN (not always up)
- is sign-aware (magnitude rounds the same, sign preserved)
- returns 0 for 0
- throws on a non-finite amount (never silently coerce a NaN/Infinity into a $ value)
